instruction: Studio photograph, medium-wide shot. A line of cheerleaders poses against a clean white backdrop. From left to right: the brown-haired woman (R10), the blonde woman (R2), the dark-haired woman (R3), the curly-haired woman (R1), the purple-haired woman (R7), the short black-haired woman (R4), the dark brown-haired woman (R9), and the long dark-haired woman (R6). They wear matching white 'Warsaw Mets' t-shirts and white cheer skirts. Each cheerleader stands with hands on hips, holding shiny orange pom-poms, looking forward with a serious, confident expression. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows.
